title: BlockDropItemStack
description: Represents an itemstack that is dropped by chance when breaking a block

attributes.description: Tree Attributes that should be attached to the resulting itemstack

code.description: Code of the block or item

dropModbyStat.description: If set, the drop quantity will be modified by the collecting entity stat code - entity.Stats.GetBlended(code)

lastDrop.description: If true and the quantity dropped is >= 1 any subsequent drop bill be ignored

tool.description: If not null then given tool is required to break this block
